reviews.author: SeekJohn14v6
reviews.text:
I parked by the Lakehouse tap and checked out the beautiful lake, which seems to be packed with fish.

Then I travelled to the trails that I took a picture of. The forest trails are nice and well kept. Plenty of flora and fauna all around. There is also a trail to a quarry pond which is pretty cool.

The lush forest provided excellent cooling shade as I explored the area. The forest loop trail had a very interesting tree that had a hole in it, check it out on my pics.

The lake area had plenty of benches with grills and there was even a boat rental place and a store for goods. Nice bathrooms and accomodations. A very nice park to visit with your friends and family. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Deborah W.
reviews.text: Beautiful Fellowship with my Camping Buddies, Family, and Friends!  They played volleyball, rode their bikes and roller skating, went swimming 🏊‍♂️, and adults and youth raising.  Other campers, kids, and Family joined us in fun activities to including dining with us.  This was a beautiful day.  Thank you to park Staff Gentleman for putting up the Volleyball net because my extended family had a Volleyball ready!  We had three sites together ❤️

reviews.author: Logan M.
reviews.text: This campground is awesome. Spots are large, open, and plenty of flat ground for a tent or three. Definitely recommend walking to the lake but the real highlight was the old growth forest trails! Budget out at least an hour or two to walk around the trails but maybe take some extra time! The campground itself can be quite loud on weekends in the summer but the trails were super quiet and peaceful. A little something for everyone. Would definitely go again!

reviews.author: J W.
reviews.text:
The lake and trails are great with super friendly staff!  We go every chance we get.  It can get pretty crowded around the water and swimming areas as well as the campsites are pretty full in good weather but it is worth it!

Just watch out for fishing line along the edges of the water.  My dog got caught in some line and I had to go in to untangle him.

reviews.author: Ben S.
reviews.text: Big chill! Great forest camping. The sites are spacious and clean. The other campers were respectful, some kids but not too loud. Most sites are in the trees and shaded. Lots of trails to walk or run. Bathrooms are nice with toilet paper and shower facility.
